mapper.select: select ID, USER_ID, NAME, STATUS, CREATED_AT from AGENT where USER_ID = #{user_id} and NAME = #{name}
select ID, USER_ID, NAME, STATUS, CREATED_AT from AGENT where ID = #{id}
mapper.update: update AGENT set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AGENT (user_id, name, status, created_at) values (#{user_id}, #{name}, #{status}, #{created_at})
